emit_config.note: every knob EmitConfig declares, its resolved value, and where that value came from (clap's own ValueSource, not inferred). `replay` is the env assignments that reproduce this configuration; defaults are omitted so a replayed build follows the tree's defaults rather than pinning today's.
emit_config.covers: knobs declared by EmitConfig; env vars read outside it are named under `unrecorded_env`, which reports their value but cannot describe them

lean.note: `verified` = a Lean ordering certificate (plow_verify checkpoint D) was obtained for EVERY program in this blob; `oracle` = the Lean decode lower-bound query ran. false means NOT CHECKED (see `reason`), never `checked and rejected` — a rejection aborts emission, so a blob with a rejected program never reaches disk and has no manifest.

campaign_scripts.quality-campaign.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export PLOW_MLA_PF_V2=1 PLOW_MLA_PF_AITER=1 PLOW_PF_CHUNK=8192 PLOW_PF_INTERLEAVE=0
export PLOW_HSACO=/tmp/tp-glm53-lt-native/objects
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$ROCM_PATH/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"
/tmp/tp-glm53-lt-native/plowrt serve --assets /tmp/tp-glm53-lt-native/assets --port 18969 > /tmp/tp-glm53-lt-native/server.log 2>&1 &
server=$!
trap 'kill -TERM "$server" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$server" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
ready=0
for attempt in $(seq 1 180); do
    if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:18969/v1/models > /tmp/tp-glm53-lt-native/models.json 2>/dev/null; then ready=1; break; fi
    kill -0 "$server" || exit 1
    sleep 1
done
[ "$ready" = 1 ]
python3 runtime/bench/amd/mla_sparse_aiter/quality.py http://127.0.0.1:18969 gemm-lt-b8 /tmp/tp-glm53-lt-native/quality8.json --concurrency 8 > /tmp/tp-glm53-lt-native/quality8.log 2>&1

campaign_scripts.bench-campaign.sh:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
export PLOW_MLA_PF_V2=1 PLOW_MLA_PF_AITER=1 PLOW_PF_CHUNK=8192 PLOW_PF_INTERLEAVE=0
export PLOW_HSACO=/tmp/tp-glm53-lt-native/objects
export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$ROCM_PATH/lib:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"
/tmp/tp-glm53-lt-native/plowrt serve --assets /tmp/tp-glm53-lt-native/assets --port 18969 > /tmp/tp-glm53-lt-native/server-perf.log 2>&1 &
server=$!
trap 'kill -TERM "$server" 2>/dev/null || true; wait "$server" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
ready=0
for attempt in $(seq 1 180); do
    if curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:18969/v1/models > /tmp/tp-glm53-lt-native/models.json 2>/dev/null; then ready=1; break; fi
    kill -0 "$server" || exit 1
    sleep 1
done
[ "$ready" = 1 ]
env VLLM_ROCM_LIB=/opt/rocm/core-7.14/lib /app/plow/build-gemma31/vllm-python -m vllm.entrypoints.cli.main bench serve --backend vllm --host 127.0.0.1 --port 18969 --model glm-5.3-plow-lite --tokenizer zai-org/GLM-5.3 --trust-remote-code --dataset-name random --num-prompts 20 --random-input-len 70000 --random-output-len 700 --random-range-ratio 0.14 --max-concurrency 20 --save-result --save-detailed --result-dir /tmp/tp-glm53-lt-native --result-filename serve-20.json > /tmp/tp-glm53-lt-native/bench20.log 2>&1
python3 - <<'CHECK'
import json
x=json.load(open('/tmp/tp-glm53-lt-native/serve-20.json'))
assert x['completed']==20 and x['failed']==0 and x['total_output_tokens']>0, x
CHECK
